meta.title: NOH: make a music video from your photos, clips and a song
meta.description: NOH turns your photos, clips and a song into a music video, on your own computer. Free download for Windows and Linux.
hero.title: Turn your photos, clips and a song into a music video.
hero.lede: NOH repeats your pictures for the length of the song, puts the lyrics on screen if you want them, and exports the video. It all happens on your computer: no account, and your media is never uploaded.
hero.caption: A drawing of NOH {drawn} playing a project: the pictures repeat until the song ends, with the lyrics as karaoke captions.
win.facts: Installer, {size_web}. For Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit. While it installs, it downloads only the parts you choose.
win.warn: Windows may warn about an unknown publisher: choose {more}, then {run}. Why

other.facts: NOH runs on 64-bit Windows 10 and 11, and on 64-bit Linux. Mac: not yet.
release.line: Version {version}, released on {date}. Free and open source under the GPL-3.0 licence.
how.title: How it works
step.caption: Step {n}, an animated drawing of NOH {drawn}
step1.title: Add your photos and clips
step1.text: Drop them into the window and put them in order. Photos in JPEG or PNG, videos in MP4, MOV, MKV or WebM.
step2.title: Add your song
step2.text: As a WAV file. NOH repeats your pictures until the song ends, and you watch the result right away.
step3.title: Add the lyrics, if you want
step3.text: NOH writes them from the song, on your computer (on Windows: with the Complete install, or added later from the app), or imports a subtitle file.
step4.title: Correct them and set their timing
step4.text: Click a line to fix a word. To time the lyrics, play the song and hold Space while each line is sung, by line, word or syllable.
step5.title: Put them on the video
step5.text: Turn on the captions and pick one of six styles, karaoke included.
step6.title: Export the video
step6.text: NOH writes an MP4 file next to your song, ready to share or to upload where you want.
more.short.title: Vertical shorts
more.short.text: Select a moment on the waveform and export it in vertical format for phones.
more.quality.title: Your video quality kept
more.quality.text: When your clips allow it, NOH copies them as they are instead of compressing them again.
more.lang.title: In your language
more.lang.text: English, French, German, Spanish, Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese.

In Edge, if the file is held in the downloads list, first choose {keep}, then {keepanyway} (under {showmore}, or next to {del} in recent versions).
linux.req: 64-bit PC (x86-64). Built for Ubuntu 24.04 and similar distributions.
linux.zip.text: NOH with offline lyrics transcription. Uses your system's FFmpeg and libmpv.
linux.step1: Install FFmpeg and libmpv from your distribution. On Ubuntu or Debian:
linux.step2: Extract the whole ZIP into a new, empty folder, with your file manager or unzip: they keep NOH's files executable.
linux.step3: Open a terminal in that folder and run ./NOH.AppDir/AppRun.
mac.text: There is no Mac download for now. NOH can be built on a Mac from its source code: build instructions.
dl.all: Every version and its release notes
mcp.title: Use NOH from your AI assistant
mcp.intro: NOH comes with a local MCP server, noh-mcp. An AI assistant that supports local MCP servers can then work with NOH for you: you ask, NOH does the work on your computer.
mcp.li1: Assemble a montage from your pictures, clips and song, preview it and export it.
mcp.li2: Write the lyrics from a song, on your computer (with the transcription component).
mcp.li3: Put captions on a video, in any of the six caption styles.
mcp.li4: Cut a vertical short from a moment of a video.
mcp.privacy: Your media stays where it is. The assistant sends NOH instructions with file paths and gets results back, never the files themselves. The server has no web listener and uploads nothing.
